_doc: City-name canonicalization for sold-listings dropdown. Maps every observed variant in the NLAR cache to a single canonical form. Built from the 2026-05-11 sold-cache inventory of 870 distinct city values. The generator's _normalize_city() function applies this map before grouping/dropdown logic, collapsing punctuation/spacing variants into one display name. Mike: review the 'canonical' values + add any small-town variants I missed.
_threshold: 50+ sales over 2-year rolling window → major-centre dropdown entry (per Mike's 2026-05-11 decision via AskUserQuestion).

Logy Bay-Middle Cove-Outer Cove: Logy Bay - Middle Cove - Outer Cove

Logy Bay Middle Cove Outer Cove

Logy Bay- Middle Cove- Outer Cove

_review_notes: Mike review: I biased toward common-sense canonicalization. The St. John's variants pattern (period vs no-period, curly apostrophe vs straight, hyphen) applies broadly. If I missed a variant, add it under the canonical entry.

Bishop's Falls + Spaniard's Bay + the Heart's-* family: backtick (`) variants exist because some agents typed on systems that converted apostrophes oddly. Catch-all in the generator could also strip-and-rebuild on apostrophe class.
Conception Bay South vs CBS: the 'Cbs' (50 sales) variant in the cache today is interesting - might be agent shorthand. Worth verifying.

Brigus + Brigus Junction: kept SEPARATE — un-merged 2026-06-07 for active-listing accuracy (Brigus is the main community; Brigus Junction is a distinct settlement with its own listings). Was previously merged for the sold dropdown only.
Goose Bay vs Happy Valley vs Happy Valley-Goose Bay: officially the amalgamated name is 'Happy Valley-Goose Bay' but locals say either. I've folded both partial names into the canonical.

2026-08-13 sold-tree slug-duplicate cleanup — 10 new/renamed canonical entries, geo-verified (lat/lng centroid distance) against the live sold feed before merging. Deliberately NOT merged: 'freshwater' vs 'freshwater-placentia' (freshwater itself is ambiguous — 5 of 8 rows cluster with freshwater-placentia near Placentia, 4 cluster ~55km north near Carbonear/Harbour Grace; these are two genuinely distinct real NL communities sharing one raw CityText value, not a spelling variant — needs geography-aware per-row disambiguation, not a name-based canonical merge, to fix correctly). 'bonne-bay-big-pond' vs 'bonne-bay-pond' also deliberately left alone — only 0.6km apart and low volume (2 vs 18), but both appear as separately-named Expedia destinations near Gros Morne and I could not independently confirm they're the same locality rather than two adjacent named places; flagging rather than guessing (Conv #175).
